subject: Secure SDLC provenance - HarborBank security intake (code review & CI evidence)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@harborbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborBank Security Team <security@harborbank.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SDLC provenance samples and CI artifact evidence

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this. HarborBank's security assessment team is performing a targeted review of secure development controls for a vendor intake. We need a concise package covering the last 90 days, focused on: 

- Code review sampling: representative PRs (merged and reverted) with reviewer tags and timestamps (we only need redacted diffs).
- CI/CD controls: pipeline run timestamps, ephemeral credential usage (e.g., short-lived tokens), and evidence of runner isolation for builds.
- Secrets management: rotation logs, access approvals, and KMS usage notes.
- Change management: change approvals and rollback/incident traces for any service-impacting releases.

Goal: a compact manifest and artifacts we can feed into our assessor (SOC 2 / CAIQ intake). Deadline: EOD Friday, 2026-09-17. Redactions are fine where necessary (e.g., internal hostnames, AWS account IDs).

Can you confirm what you can provide and any follow-up questions? If easier, upload to a shared drive link and I can download from there.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Security Intake Lead
HarborBank

[HarborBank: intake ticket HD-44822]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@harborbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC provenance samples and CI artifact evidence

Alice — thanks for the clear scope. We can assemble a compact package for the 90-day window. Plan below: 

1) Marissa will prepare a PR sample bundle with redacted diffs (3 merged, 1 reverted) and a CSV manifest describing reviewer, timestamps, and redaction notes.
2) Jordan will pull CI pipeline run logs and produce a short timeline showing ephemeral credential rotations and runner isolation evidence.
3) I will compile change-approval receipts and any rollbacks/incidents tied to releases in the window.

We will: 
- Produce a single manifest CSV that maps each artifact (PR, pipeline run, change) to the attached evidence.
- Redact identifiers as requested and annotate what was redacted.

Upload plan: we will stage artifacts in a restricted Drive folder and send the link. Expected delivery: Thursday EOD (2026-09-16) — earlier if possible.

Are you okay with the Thursday delivery? If HarborBank requires document-level signatures for chain-of-custody, let me know and we'll include the audit trail.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

[Attachment: intake_acknowledgement.pdf (stub)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@harborbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SDLC package: HarborBank — manifest and artifacts (staged)

Alice — forwarding the package we staged for HarborBank. Summary: 

- sdlc_sample_manifest.csv: mapping of artifacts (PR IDs redacted, reviewer handle, merge/revert timestamps, redaction notes).
- ci_pipeline_timeline.pdf: high-level timeline of pipeline runs (build IDs redacted), marker annotations for ephemeral token rotations and runner isolation checks.
- redacted_prs.zip: three redacted merged PRs and one reverted PR with reviewer comments preserved.

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.redwood/reports/harborbank/sdlc_manifest
HubSpot intake: https://hubspot.company/record/HD-44822

Attachments included below (stubs):
[Attachment: sdlc_sample_manifest.csv (11KB, CSV)]
[Attachment: ci_pipeline_timeline.pdf (6.3MB, PDF)]
[Attachment: redacted_prs.zip (2.1MB, ZIP)]

Notes on redaction: we removed internal worker hostnames and replaced AWS account numbers with aliases (account-REDACTED-1). Each redaction is annotated in the CSV with the reason. CI artifacts include a short, signed excerpt of the runner identity verification produced by our orchestration layer.

If you want a single consolidated PDF instead of separate files, say the word and we’ll produce a stamped manifest that lists SHA256 checksums and who uploaded each artifact.

—Jordan
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@harborbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborBank Security Team <security@harborbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC package: HarborBank — manifest and artifacts (staged)

Jordan — received, thank you. The artifacts and manifest look good based on a preliminary scan. Two quick asks before we close the intake: 

1) Please produce the consolidated manifest PDF with checksums and a short note about how ephemeral credential rotation is enforced (we only need one A4 page describing the policy + where rotation logs are kept).
2) In the CSV, can you add a column that indicates whether a PR had an automated security scan (SAST) pass/fail for that run? If you can mark N/A where scanners didn't run, that's fine.

Redactions are acceptable. If possible, please deliver those final items by EOD Thursday (2026-09-16) so our assessor can ingest them on Friday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alice Nguyen
Security Intake Lead
HarborBank
security@harborbank.com
